edges.reason: Caller address msg.sender is used as the sender in the public transfer function.
transfer() calls the internal _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer with the supplied sender and recipient.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
transferFrom() reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
approve() writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
_transfer() finishes by dispatching into _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer() routes execution to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard() invokes _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard() invokes _reflectFee for the reflection fee.
_transferStandard() subtracts from sender and adds to recipient reflection balances.
_takeTeam() credits the contract reflection balance in _rOwned.
_reflectFee() subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_takeTeam() reads the current reflection rate from _getRate().
isExcludedFromFee decides whether _transferStandard applies fees or not.
isExcludedFromLimit gates the anti-whale amount checks in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount checked in _transfer.
_maxWalletAmount bounds the recipient balance checked in _transfer.
bots mapping is consulted to block blacklisted senders/recipients.
cooldown mapping is read and written inside _transfer.
Cooldown expiry is computed directly from block.timestamp, making it miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
_transfer() calls swapTokensForEth mid-transaction when the balance threshold is met.
swapTokensForEth() performs an external router swap before state settles.
_transfer() calls sendETHToFee right after the swap.
sendETHToFee() transfers half of the ETH to fee wallet 1.
sendETHToFee() transfers half of the ETH to fee wallet 2.
inSwap flag guards against recursive automatic swaps inside _transfer.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap while swapTokensForEth executes.
manualSwap authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualSend authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is used as the authorization principal for manualSwap.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner restriction on openTrading.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner restriction on setBots.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner restriction on changeMaxTxAmount.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner restriction on excludeFromFees.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner restriction on excludeFromLimits.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner restriction on setCooldownEnabled.
_owner enforces the onlyOwner restriction on delBot.
openTrading() makes an external addLiquidityETH call with the contract's ETH balance.
openTrading() calls the factory to create the Uniswap pair.
openTrading() assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading() stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
manualSwap() executes an immediate external swap of the contract balance.
manualSend() immediately forwards the entire contract ETH balance.
setBots() writes blacklist flags into the bots mapping.
delBot() clears the blacklist flag in the bots mapping.
excludeFromFees() writes to isExcludedFromFee.
excludeFromLimits() writes to isExcludedFromLimit.
changeMaxTxAmount() writes the new limit into _maxTxAmount.
setCooldownEnabled() writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
The external router swap can re-enter the token transfer path before swap state completes.
swapTokensForEth() uses the stored uniswapV2Router for the external swap.
_getRate() derives the rate from _rTotal, whose division defines reflection math.
The from parameter flows into address/bot/limit checks within _transfer.
The to parameter flows into recipient balance and limit checks in _transfer.
The amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount and the sender balance.
contractTokenBalance is the amount forwarded to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee for distribution.
The recipient parameter is passed from transfer() into _transfer.
The account parameter selects which address to exempt in excludeFromFees.
The bots_ array is iterated to populate the bots blacklist.
The loop index i controls iteration over the bots_ array.
The amount parameter becomes the new _maxTxAmount value.
The path array is consumed by the external router swap call.
currentRate is used to convert the team fee into reflection units.
The tokenAmount parameter is the amountIn of the router swap.
The amount parameter is divided and sent to fee wallet 1.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to parameterize the _transfer call and carries no independent semantics.
The to parameter is an input of _transfer and should be collapsed into that function node.
The internal transfer amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
This local exists solely to feed the swap amount into swapTokensForEth.
This local exists solely to supply the ETH value passed to sendETHToFee.
The recipient parameter belongs to the public transfer function it parameterizes.
The account parameter is only used to index isExcludedFromFee inside excludeFromFees.
The bots_ array is the sole input of setBots and has no meaning elsewhere.
The loop index is an implementation detail of the setBots iteration.
The amount parameter is assigned directly to _maxTxAmount by changeMaxTxAmount.
The path array is constructed and consumed only within swapTokensForEth.
The rate local is used only to compute the team reflection amount in _takeTeam.
The token amount is the direct input amount of the external router swap operation.
The ETH amount is split and forwarded directly to the fee wallet transfer operation.
